description: Defines the rx::Image11 class, which serves as an interface to underlying Texture resources in a Direct3D 11 rendering context within ANGLE project. Contains class declarations, method signatures, and includes relevant for D3D11 image handling.

classes.name: Image11
classes.description: Represents a D3D11 image resource, providing methods for image data management, copying, and state validation within ANGLE's rendering pipeline.

methods.name: Image11
methods.description: Constructor initializing Image11 with a Renderer11 reference.

methods.name: ~Image11
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: GenerateMipmap
methods.description: Generates mipmaps for the image.

methods.name: CopyImage
methods.description: Copies image data from source to destination.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the image has unsaved changes.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies image data to a specified texture storage.

methods.name: redefine
methods.description: Redefines the image with new texture type, format, and size.

methods.name: getDXGIFormat
methods.description: Returns the DXGI format of the image.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads uncompressed pixel data into the image.

methods.name: loadCompressedData
methods.description: Loads compressed pixel data into the image.

methods.name: copyFromTexStorage
methods.description: Copies data from a texture storage source.

methods.name: copyFromFramebuffer
methods.description: Copies data from a framebuffer source.

methods.name: recoverFromAssociatedStorage
methods.description: Recovers image data from associated storage if needed.

methods.name: verifyAssociatedStorageValid
methods.description: Validates the associated storage.

methods.name: disassociateStorage
methods.description: Disassociates the image from its storage.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the image resource for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the image resource.

methods.name: copyWithoutConversion
methods.description: Copies image data without format conversion.

methods.name: getStagingTexture
methods.description: Retrieves the staging texture for read/write operations.

methods.name: createStagingTexture
methods.description: Creates a staging texture for the image.

methods.name: releaseStagingTexture
methods.description: Releases the staging texture.
